paragraph: Today’s primary Granville composite reading prints a deeply defensive 19 out of 100, signaling a clear continuation of institutional liquidation with no breadth divergence warning to offer any contrarian hope. The underlying internals confirm this pessimism, led by a severe 16.73% surge in the VIX to a fearful level of 28.67, alongside a backwardated vol term structure and front-loaded skew showing aggressive hedging demand. Risk appetite is firmly in retreat as high-beta stocks underperform low-volatility counterparts by 0.89%, defensive consumer staples outpace discretionary issues by 1.38%, and bellwether semis drop 0.80% relative to the broader market. Meanwhile, macro crosscurrents remain relatively orderly with stable 10-year real yields at 2.88% and steady high-yield credit spreads at 3.47%, suggesting the equity weakness is driven by internal risk-off rotation rather than systemic credit stress. Expect sellers to retain control throughout today's session as the tape digests this broad-based defensive posture.
